name: server-foundation
description: A reusable TypeScript API foundation for desktop applications.

scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/api... build && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/api test && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/auth test && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/mysql-adapter test && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/redis-adapter test && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/local-fs-storage test && corepack pnpm test:backup
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm test:integration:mysql && corepack pnpm test:integration:redis && corepack pnpm test:integration:api
scripts.test:integration:api: corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/api exec vitest run test/auth.integration.test.ts test/files.integration.test.ts
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/api... build && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/mysql-adapter build && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/redis-adapter build && corepack pnpm --filter @server-foundation/local-fs-storage build
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm contract:fixtures && corepack pnpm test:create-user && corepack pnpm test:wg-sync && corepack pnpm test:offsite-backup && corepack pnpm test:boot-survival && corepack pnpm boot:accept
